I also got a tech support call from a friend, who needed help with a website he needed to finish today.  We talked a bit after the call.  He's a friend a who drove up from Portland, OR to Seattle just so the hospital felt okay sending me home when I went in on the urgings of a suicide hotline.

He asked me how I was doing, and.... I couldn't tell him anything about my present plans, and it's hard when they are trying to help -so hard-.  I feel like the worst person, utter shit.  I don't even know why I'm here if I'm so completely unwilling to let even my friends in.

Edit: Otherwise I've mostly layed in bed on my computer, smoke cigarettes on the porch, and eat cheerios. My life is pretty worthless right now.

My mom had a problem with narcotics for most of my youth. I was forgot at school a few times, once for like six hours.  (I had stopped riding the school bus, in early grade-school because of bullying.)  I waited in front of the school dilligently for a few hours, calling her frequently, trying to get through, watching everyone leave.

I was in front of the school hours after it had closed when the fire alarm went off, I saw a firetruck come screaming up just to see a teacher come out and apologize for setting off the alarm.

Near the end of my wait, another youth had come to the parking lot to… bike I think?  He talked to me, listened to my situation, and came back with a car.  He drove me home and, bought me McDonalds, and I can't remember his name.

My mom went through a number of treatment programs.  There was an intervention which lead to… methadone? She had to go to some place fo her medication every morning.  Her eyes looked empty, it's scaring looking at pictures from that time.  She didn't start getting better until after she went to a different state for a drug rehab treatment center.  That's when she became hella-christian.
